title: Solomon’s Wisdom and Wealth

questions.question: Where did Solomon and the assembly go to offer sacrifices?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 1:3 (ESV): "Solomon, and all the assembly with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon..."

questions.question: What was at Gibeon that made it significant?
options: The tent of meeting of God
questions.correctAnswer: The tent of meeting of God
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 1:3 (ESV): "...for the tent of meeting of God... was there."

questions.question: What did God ask Solomon in the night?
options: Ask what I shall give you
questions.correctAnswer: Ask what I shall give you
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 1:7 (ESV): "In that night God appeared to Solomon, and said to him, 'Ask what I shall give you.'"

questions.question: What did Solomon ask for?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 1:10 (ESV): "Give me now wisdom and knowledge to go out and come in before this people..."

questions.question: What additional gifts did God grant Solomon?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 1:12 (ESV): "...I will also give you riches, possessions, and honor..."

questions.question: How many burnt offerings did Solomon offer at Gibeon?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 1:6 (ESV): "...and offered a thousand burnt offerings on it."

questions.question: Where was the ark of God at this time?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 1:4 (ESV): "David had brought up the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim to the place that David had prepared for it, for he had pitched a tent for it in Jerusalem."

questions.question: Who originally made the bronze altar that was at Gibeon?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 1:5 (ESV): "Moreover, the bronze altar that Bezalel the son of Uri, son of Hur, had made, was there..."

questions.question: From where did Solomon import horses?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 1:16 (ESV): "Solomon's import of horses was from Egypt and Kue..."

questions.question: What was the price of a chariot imported from Egypt?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 1:17 (ESV): "They imported a chariot from Egypt for 600 shekels of silver..."

questions.question: To whom did Solomon export horses?
options: All the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Syria
questions.correctAnswer: All the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Syria
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 1:17 (ESV): "...And so through them these were exported to all the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Syria."

questions.question: What did Solomon make as common as stone in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 1:15 (ESV): "And the king made silver and gold as common in Jerusalem as stone..."

questions.question: How many horsemen did Solomon station in the chariot cities and Jerusalem?
What trees did Solomon make as plentiful as sycamores?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 1:15 (ESV): "...and he made cedar as plentiful as the sycamore of the Shephelah."

questions.question: Who was Bezalel’s grandfather?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 1:5 (ESV): "...Bezalel the son of Uri, son of Hur..."

key_verse_text: Give me now wisdom and knowledge to go out and come in before this people, for who can govern this people of yours, which is so great?
